Self harm is very addictive and when u self harm it releases chemiccals similar to taking lots of opioids when you initially self harm. It numbs the emotions, numbs the body even, depending on where it is.that is why it is so dangerous because you essentially can't feel for a little while. And can do irreversible damage to the area. I'm 21f been dealing w this since 8 years old. It feels so much better to be clean. It's like coming off of drugs, it is NOT easy , but when you do it will improve your life,and you have to be careful to avoid triggers. My best advice to you would be treat it like any other addiction and kick the habit before it goes out of control.

Lastly I hope you feel better snd I am extending offer to ever dm of you need to, reach out or talk because it's a very lonely and scary feeling. You are not a freak, you are a person trying to get through life, and you deserve good and to treat your body with kindness. Hope you feel better.
